arguments.value: User reports a Blue Yeti microphone on Ubuntu 20.04 no longer offers duplex mode in pavucontrol. Yeti only shows analog/digital input or output profiles, so input/output can’t be selected simultaneously and one side switches to another device. Concern is that duplex profile disappeared after not using the mic for a month; asks what changed and whether any driver/update is needed.
